onbInvestBody: RAKIB reads the pack. MUNZIR checks recalls. RAFIQ flags interactions. HAKIM signs the verdict — so you don't have to guess.

privacyDataCollectionBody: DawaaCheck collects only the data necessary to provide medicine verification services. This includes scanned medicine images (processed in real-time and not stored on our servers), your account information (name, email), and scan history for your convenience.
privacyHowWeUseBody: Your data is used solely to verify medicines, maintain your scan history, and improve our AI verification accuracy. We do not sell, share, or distribute your personal data to third parties.
privacyCameraStorageBody: DawaaCheck requires camera access to scan medicine packaging. Photos are processed through our AI agents and are not permanently stored. No images are shared with external services.
privacyAuthenticationBody: We use Firebase Authentication for secure sign-in. Your credentials are encrypted and handled by Google's secure infrastructure. We never store passwords directly.
privacyAdrBody: ADR reports you submit are stored securely and may be shared with DRAP (Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan) to improve public health safety. Reports are anonymized before sharing.
privacyDataSecurityBody: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest. We use Supabase and Firebase with enterprise-grade security. Row-level security ensures you can only access your own data.
privacyYourRightsBody: You can delete your account and all associated data at any time. Contact us at support@dawaacheck.com for data deletion requests.
aboutDescription: Pakistan's first AI-powered medicine verification app. DawaaCheck uses 10 specialized AI agents to instantly verify medicine authenticity, check for recalls, drug interactions, and side effects — protecting you and your family from counterfeit and unsafe medicines.
